title: Authenticate stable machines over byte transparent transports

cases.happy: Connect two isolated runtimes over a stdio argv transport, rename the machine while a request bound to it waits, and verify the destination machine_id and the fresh remote_boot_id proven by the boot challenge are unchanged.
cases.failure: machine.add with params.expected_machine_id = wrong-machine returns trust_mismatch before any machine is recorded; protocol stdout carries no banner or credential prompt.

executed_today_by: cargo test -p ovis-terminal-server --lib machine_identity (two real runtimes joined by a real child relay over FIFOs)
